text_first_baseline.summary: The baseline condition captures the expert comment and suggests a correction, but it does not keep raw opinion, failure-mode classification, prevention mechanism and reviewed proposal boundary fully separate.

graph_field_guided.summary: The graph-field condition classifies the finding, maps it to a prevention mechanism and keeps the improvement as a reviewed proposal rather than a direct canonical change.
graph_field_guided.boundary_statement: Method-improvement proposal only; no independent validation claim.

notes: Baseline condition needs reviewer correction to separate raw opinion from durable prevention mechanism.
Baseline condition risks treating expert review as stronger evidence than it supports.
Graph-field condition preserves classification, prevention mapping and reviewed proposal boundary.
Graph-field condition keeps canonical update outside the direct review-processing action.

claim_boundary: This execution record supports only internal non-independent pilot evidence for one expert-review-loop fixture. It does not support general effectiveness, production quality or independent validation claims.
